entries.anchor: The source is the single capture `⟦capture⟧`, re-derived under the current rate-aware anchor `⟦anchor⟧`.

Their medians are ⟦onset_median⟧ ms and ⟦offset_median⟧ ms.

Blue and orange dashed horizontal lines mark the respective medians, ⟦onset_median⟧ ms and ⟦offset_median⟧ ms;
